title: More Curriculum Time for Education and Career Guidance in Secondary Schools
what_it_is: More Curriculum Time for Education and Career Guidance in Secondary Schools

sections.label: Education and career guidance in curriculum
sections.summary: MOE recognises guiding students to develop awareness of strengths and interests and explore education and career pathways, complemented by experiences beyond the classroom.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) recognises the importance of guiding students to develop a greater awareness of their strengths and their interests, and explore various education and career pathways at each stage of their educational journey.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Curriculum time that is spent on education and career guidance (ECG) is complemented by student development experiences beyond the classroom.

sections.label: MySkillsFuture Student Portal access
sections.summary: The MySkillsFuture Student Portal is available to students from Primary 5 to support self-directed exploration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To support students in self-directed exploration, the MySkillsFuture Student Portal is available to students from Primary 5.

sections.label: ECG counsellors and curriculum review
sections.summary: ECG counsellors are available to secondary and pre-university students, and MOE will continue reviewing curriculum time allocation for holistic development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Access to ECG counsellors is also available to students from secondary schools and pre-university institutions who require more guidance in exploring suitable education pathways and career possibilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE reviews our curriculum regularly and we will continue to review curriculum time allocation to ensure that students are well-supported in their holistic development, including in education and career guidance.

sections.label: Geography teaching and job awareness
sections.summary: The speaker says geography is taught well, job awareness matters, and curriculum time allocation will be reviewed in the age of artificial intelligence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: We teach geography very well, and maybe we can do the same for job awareness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: I think there are many skills that are key to our students' future development and career success, so this is not a competition between subjects.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We must ensure that all students have good access to both knowledge acquisition as well as career preps for the future.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my reply, we will be continuing to review curriculum time allocation, and all the more we need to do so in the age of artificial intelligence, where a lot more focus will be on human skills that are increasingly important for our students.
